n287fa3c633.headline: Gina Rinehart becomes largest shareholder in MP Materials
n287fa3c633.summary: Gina Rinehart has become the largest shareholder in MP Materials, a rare earths producer. The report comes from Yahoo Finance, which notes that the company's CEO and founder is James Litinsky.
n287fa3c633.why: MP Materials is a US rare earths miner and magnet producer, so shifts in its ownership can signal investor interest in critical minerals supply chains.

nbac9dbcafa.headline: Is a 50-year mortgage really that much crazier than a 30-year one?
nbac9dbcafa.summary: President Trump's proposal for a 50-year mortgage drew wide criticism online. The article argues that such a loan may not be as extreme as it sounds compared with a 30-year mortgage.
nbac9dbcafa.why: Mortgage terms shape housing affordability and lender economics, which matter for US housing finance and related stocks.

source.name: Northern Public Radio: WNIJ and WNIU

sources.name: Northern Public Radio: WNIJ and WNIU

n519b5ea182.headline: Kenya: Rural Kenya Drives 60% of Online Purchases As E-Commerce Expands, Jumia Report Shows
n519b5ea182.summary: A Jumia report shows rural Kenya now accounts for 60 percent of all Jumia orders, overtaking major cities as the growth engine for e-commerce in the country.
n519b5ea182.why: Jumia is an African e-commerce platform listed in New York, so changes in its order mix bear on its growth and the wider digital retail trend in Africa.

n0b85153f43.headline: Nigeria’s next freedom: The need for building and construction safety
n0b85153f43.summary: Nigeria's construction sector accounts for around 5% of national GDP and grew 6.2% year-on-year in the first quarter of 2025, according to the National Bureau of Statistics.
n0b85153f43.why: Construction is a key indicator of economic activity and infrastructure investment in Nigeria, Africa's largest economy by population.

nf99db690fa.headline: TNPA, uMhlathuze renew port–city pact to fast-track major development projects
nf99db690fa.summary: Transnet National Ports Authority and the City of uMhlathuze renewed their cooperation agreement to speed up infrastructure and economic development projects in Richards Bay.
nf99db690fa.why: Richards Bay is a major South African bulk port, and port infrastructure affects export logistics for minerals and commodities.

nd0f85f95d7.headline: Ituran:  Q3 Earnings Snapshot
nd0f85f95d7.summary: Ituran Location and Control reported third-quarter profit of $14.6 million, with net income of 74 cents per share, according to a MarketScreener snapshot.
nd0f85f95d7.why: Ituran is an Israeli vehicle location and fleet-management company, and its quarterly profit indicates trends in its tracking and telematics business.

na876fc23f5.headline: Reliance Jio, NSE, Flipkart and more: The who’s who of India Inc lining up $20-billion IPOs for 2026
na876fc23f5.summary: Reliance Jio, NSE, PhonePe, Flipkart, OYO and SBI Mutual Fund are preparing IPOs that could collectively raise up to $20 billion in 2026, after a record five-year fundraising boom.
na876fc23f5.why: A large IPO pipeline signals deeper Indian capital markets and gives investors new listings, while absorbing significant domestic and foreign capital.

nd7653e845b.headline: The Cedi has regained respect - President Mahama
nd7653e845b.summary: President John Dramani Mahama praised the management of Ghana's currency, saying the cedi has regained respect both locally and internationally.
nd7653e845b.why: Currency stability affects import costs, inflation and the returns foreign investors earn on Ghanaian assets.

n2e5e4f2b40.headline: Aiming to attract capital to Canada, Carney departing for two of world’s largest emerging markets
n2e5e4f2b40.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney departs on a nearly week-long trip to the United Arab Emirates and South Africa, seeking trade and investment agreements. He aims to deepen diplomatic ties.
n2e5e4f2b40.why: Canada's government trade and investment missions can open new export markets and foreign capital flows for Canadian firms.

n1b92330ef6.headline: Zelensky to visit Turkey in bid to ‘reinvigorate’ talks to end war
n1b92330ef6.summary: Ukraine's president will visit Turkey on Wednesday, a day after visiting Spain, where he hoped for new support pledges. The trip aims to revive talks to end the war.
n1b92330ef6.why: Progress or setbacks in Ukraine peace talks affect European energy, grain and defence markets and sanctions policy.

n31a1b3251e.headline: Mt. Gox Moves $953M Bitcoin, Causing Investor Concerns
n31a1b3251e.summary: Mt. Gox moved $953 million in Bitcoin from its cold wallet in its first large-scale transfer in eight months. The move came despite a delay in creditor payments.
n31a1b3251e.why: Mt. Gox is a bankrupt Bitcoin exchange whose remaining holdings are being distributed to creditors, so its wallet movements are closely watched for possible selling pressure.

nabe7b6cdee.headline: East Africa: AfCFTA - Nigeria Rolls Out Preferential Tariffs, Opens East Africa Air Cargo Corridor
nabe7b6cdee.summary: Nigeria has begun applying preferential tariffs to African-made goods and opened a dedicated air cargo export corridor to East Africa. The steps advance its commitments under the African Continental Free Trade Area.
nabe7b6cdee.why: AfCFTA aims to create a single African market by cutting tariffs, which can open new export routes and investment opportunities across the continent.

n37a7bc7d05.headline: Indian earnings turn a corner as cooling inflation, tax cuts lift purchasing power
n37a7bc7d05.summary: India's corporate earnings are staging their strongest recovery in over a year, with brokerages turning upbeat on second-half profit growth as inflation cools and tax cuts lift purchasing power.
n37a7bc7d05.why: Corporate earnings trends drive valuations of listed Indian companies, which make up a large share of the country's equity benchmarks.

ne4349cb4be.headline: FAAC shares over four trillion Naira in eight months, January to August 2025
ne4349cb4be.summary: The Federation Account Allocation Committee disbursed a total of ₦4.587 trillion to Nigeria's 36 states between January and August 2025.
ne4349cb4be.why: FAAC allocations are the federal revenue transfers to states, a key source of funding for subnational budgets in Nigeria.

n4784d029e7.headline: United push to demand access to Iran's nuclear sites
n4784d029e7.summary: France, Britain, Germany and the US will ask the UN atomic watchdog to demand access to Iran's nuclear facilities and its stock of enriched uranium.
n4784d029e7.why: Iran's nuclear programme is a central source of Middle East geopolitical risk, and sanctions and tensions over it influence global oil and currency markets.

n3d12db47e9.headline: We're about to get the best look at inflation we've ever had, after years in the making
n3d12db47e9.summary: A new complete monthly consumer price index will be released next week and will become Australia's primary measure of inflation. The change follows years of preparation.
n3d12db47e9.why: Consumer price indexes guide central bank interest-rate decisions, so a more complete monthly measure changes how investors read Australian inflation and rate expectations.

nd46d0b4a7d.headline: Grab Super App Eyes Stablecoin Settlement With StraitsX
nd46d0b4a7d.summary: Grab's partnership with StraitsX signals a push toward regulated, cross-border onchain payments. The company aims to embed stablecoin settlement directly in its super app.
nd46d0b4a7d.why: Grab is a Southeast Asian super app covering ride-hailing, delivery and payments. Stablecoin settlement could change how it moves money across borders.

n560514c358.headline: Who is John Ternus, and why he is the leading candidate to succeed Tim Cook as Apple CEO
n560514c358.summary: Apple is accelerating succession planning for CEO Tim Cook, who may step down as early as next year after 14 years leading the company. John Ternus is reported as the leading candidate.
n560514c358.why: Apple is one of the largest companies by market value, and leadership changes at the firm can shape its strategy, product roadmap and investor sentiment.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: A planned CEO transition at Apple could affect the company's strategic direction and investor perception.

nf8efc1508a.headline: Home Depot forecasts steeper drop in annual profit as Americans delay big projects
nf8efc1508a.summary: Home Depot forecast a bigger full-year profit drop after missing Wall Street quarterly earnings estimates. It cited tariff-driven uncertainty that dampened demand for big-ticket items.
nf8efc1508a.why: Home Depot is the largest US home improvement retailer, so its results are a read on US housing-related consumer spending.
nf8efc1508a.why_moved: Home Depot missed quarterly earnings estimates and forecast a steeper full-year profit drop, as tariff uncertainty weighed on big-ticket demand.

n374d0dd8dc.headline: Rachel Reeves to confirm £440 rise for state pensioners born before 1951
n374d0dd8dc.summary: Chancellor Rachel Reeves is set to confirm a £440 rise for state pensioners born before 1951. The new 2026 rates were determined under the triple lock policy.
n374d0dd8dc.why: The state pension is a major fiscal commitment, and the triple lock uprating links annual increases to earnings, inflation or 2.5%.

n18cd0c68c5.headline: Thousands of flat owners in England face new £6,000 charge under Labour
n18cd0c68c5.summary: Thousands of flat owners in England could face a new £6,000 charge under the Labour government. Chancellor Rachel Reeves is due to deliver the Autumn Budget on November 26.
n18cd0c68c5.why: Leasehold service charges and building-safety costs affect property values and household finances, and budget measures shape the housing market.

n32059a8ebe.headline: Trump's White House hosts Saudi Crown Prince with big deals being inked
n32059a8ebe.summary: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman will visit the White House on Tuesday, with big deals being inked, his first visit since the 2018 killing of Jamal Khashoggi.
n32059a8ebe.why: Saudi Arabia is the largest oil exporter in the Middle East, and its investment and trade agreements with the US influence energy and defence markets.

n3b10df421a.headline: Austal USA Leads Effort to Increase Submarine Industrial Base Capabilities under AUKUS
n3b10df421a.summary: Austal USA signed a memorandum of understanding with Australian Submarine Corporation at INDOPAC 2025 in Sydney. It aims to introduce 3D printing into Australian shipbuilding under AUKUS.
n3b10df421a.why: AUKUS is a trilateral defence pact that is driving large submarine programmes, and shipbuilders such as Austal supply parts and services to them.

nc7bda67769.headline: KKR reworks plan for India portfolio firm, taps new investor to dilute stake
nc7bda67769.summary: KKR is bringing a new investor into an India portfolio company and has changed its plan for monetising the six-year-old investment. The move dilutes KKR's stake.
nc7bda67769.why: KKR is a global private equity firm that invests in companies and later exits through sales or partial stake sales. Such exits influence returns for its fund investors.

n9d51df879f.headline: RBA reveals what would rule out more interest rate cuts
n9d51df879f.summary: The Reserve Bank of Australia has indicated that a material rise in unemployment or weaker-than-expected economic growth would be needed for further rate cuts. Mortgage holders face limited prospects of relief.
n9d51df879f.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate that anchors Australian mortgage pricing, bond yields and the Australian dollar.

n96152c9a36.headline: Apple Jumps to 25% Market Share in China
n96152c9a36.summary: Apple's market share in China has reached 25%, driven by strong demand for the iPhone 17 lineup. The article describes a major rebound for the company in the market.
n96152c9a36.why: China is one of Apple's largest markets, and its iPhone sales there are a key driver of the company's revenue and earnings.

impacts.name: Apple
impacts.why: A higher share in China supports iPhone sales in one of the company's key markets.

n7f106a15bf.headline: Yen finds its footing as markets wobble, investors turn risk-off
n7f106a15bf.summary: The yen rebounded from its weakest level against the dollar in over nine months in Asian trading as expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts receded.
n7f106a15bf.why: The yen is a major funding currency, and its moves affect Japanese exporters, carry trades and capital flows. The Bank of Japan and Federal Reserve policy expectations are key drivers.
n7f106a15bf.why_moved: Receding expectations of Federal Reserve rate cuts reduced the dollar's appeal, and investors moved risk-off. Both developments favour the yen after its weakest level in nine months.

nf5a5f2efe3.headline: ITURAN PRESENTS THIRD QUARTER 2025 RESULTS
nf5a5f2efe3.summary: Ituran Location and Control announced its consolidated financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2025.
nf5a5f2efe3.why: Ituran is an Israel-based vehicle location and telematics provider listed on Nasdaq. Its results indicate demand for its fleet and vehicle tracking services.

n6a1f4b640f.headline: ‘Sad day for publicly funded science’: up to 350 more jobs to go at CSIRO
n6a1f4b640f.summary: Australia's national science agency CSIRO announced up to 350 more job losses as it looks for budgetary savings.
n6a1f4b640f.why: CSIRO is Australia's national science agency, funded largely by the government. Its budget decisions affect research funding and public spending.

n8c13bd859c.headline: EPF nine-month investment income up 11%
n8c13bd859c.summary: The Employees Provident Fund posted one of its strongest nine-month investment incomes in recent years, up 11%. It signalled members should temper expectations for the final quarter of 2025.
n8c13bd859c.why: The EPF is Malaysia's mandatory retirement savings fund and one of the country's largest institutional investors, so its returns shape domestic capital markets and household savings.

na3d5a9ec06.headline: Stock Indexes Slump as the Slide in Tech Stocks Deepens
na3d5a9ec06.summary: The S&P 500 fell 1.17%, the Dow dropped 1.24% and the Nasdaq 100 lost 1.57% as the slide in tech stocks deepened, according to Yahoo Finance.
na3d5a9ec06.why: The S&P 500 and Nasdaq 100 are the main benchmarks for large US companies, and technology shares carry heavy weight in them.

impacts.name: S&P 500
impacts.why: The benchmark index fell 1.17% in the session.

impacts.why: The tech-heavy index fell 1.57%, the largest decline among the three.

na3d5a9ec06.why_moved: Losses in technology shares deepened and pulled the broader indexes lower.

n49ca251f03.headline: Stock Market Opens Lower; Metal Stocks Drag Indices
n49ca251f03.summary: Indian benchmark indices opened weak on Tuesday, with the Sensex down 164 points at 84,784 and the Nifty down 47 points at 25,965. Weakness was seen across large-, mid- and small-cap stocks.
n49ca251f03.why: The Sensex and Nifty are the main benchmark indices of India's equity market, tracking the country's largest listed companies. Metal stocks are a cyclical sector sensitive to global commodity demand.

n6f5a66e044.headline: Ukrainian Railways signs contract with Alstom for 55 electric locomotives
n6f5a66e044.summary: Ukrainian Railways has signed a contract with Alstom for 55 electric locomotives. Alstom will design and produce them at its Belfort facility in France, with deliveries starting in 2027.
n6f5a66e044.why: Alstom is a French rail equipment maker supplying trains and locomotives worldwide. Large rolling-stock orders provide multi-year revenue visibility for manufacturers.

n63dc5fcb8c.headline: Fear and caution grip markets
n63dc5fcb8c.summary: Asian markets were a sea of red on Tuesday, with the sombre mood expected to extend into Europe. Investors were described as braced and cautious ahead of the session.
n63dc5fcb8c.why: Asian and European equity markets are closely linked through global investor sentiment, so declines in Asia often carry into the European session. Market mood shapes short-term risk appetite.
n63dc5fcb8c.why_moved: Investors were braced and cautious, with the negative mood in Asia expected to carry into European trading.

n8db10bbffc.headline: Japan Bond Yields Soar To Record, Slamming Door On Stimulus Just As Economy Implodes Amid Escalating China Clash
n8db10bbffc.summary: Japanese bond yields have surged to a record, according to a ZeroHedge report. The article links the move to fiscal policy concerns and a escalating clash with China.
n8db10bbffc.why: Japan's government bond market is the world's third-largest, and its yields affect global borrowing costs and currency flows.
n8db10bbffc.why_moved: Reported record yields are linked to concerns about stimulus being constrained and a deteriorating economic outlook. The article also cites a clash with China.

naa7db8a8eb.headline: Klarna now available on Apple Pay in Denmark, Spain, and Sweden with France to follow
naa7db8a8eb.summary: Klarna's flexible payment products are now available at checkout on Apple Pay in Denmark, Spain and Sweden. France is set to follow.
naa7db8a8eb.why: Klarna is a Swedish digital bank and buy-now-pay-later provider, and its partnerships with payment platforms drive its merchant reach.

n28b4d7a1f2.headline: Philippines cash remittances up 3.7% in September to $3.1 billion
n28b4d7a1f2.summary: Cash remittances rose 3.7% from a year earlier to $3.1 billion in September, the Philippine central bank said on Monday.
n28b4d7a1f2.why: Remittances from overseas Filipino workers are a major source of foreign currency and household income in the Philippines, supporting consumption and the peso.

n6003c9137e.headline: Bitcoin Price Surges Near $94,000 After Crash Below $90,000
n6003c9137e.summary: Bitcoin briefly fell below $90,000 overnight on Tuesday, its lowest level since April, before recovering to near $94,000.
n6003c9137e.why: Bitcoin is the largest cryptocurrency by market value, and its price swings are closely watched as a gauge of risk appetite in digital-asset markets.

impacts.why: The price briefly fell below $90,000 and then recovered to near $94,000, showing high intraday volatility.

nbf42deeeda.headline: Lithium surges in China after Ganfeng chairman predicts 2026 demand boom
nbf42deeeda.summary: Lithium carbonate prices in China hit their highest since June 2024 after Ganfeng Lithium's chairman predicted a 30-40% rise in lithium demand by 2026. Supply concerns are also cited.
nbf42deeeda.why: Lithium is a key input for batteries used in electric vehicles and energy storage, so its price affects battery makers and miners.
nbf42deeeda.why_moved: Ganfeng Lithium's chairman forecast a 30-40% rise in lithium demand by 2026, and the market is pricing in growth from energy storage amid supply concerns.

ncbebbaf81a.headline: Stocks drop after another jarring day as worries about too-high prices keep dogging Nvidia, bitcoin
ncbebbaf81a.summary: The U.S. stock market fell after another volatile session as worries over high prices kept weighing on Nvidia, bitcoin and other Wall Street leaders. Nvidia was the heaviest drag.
ncbebbaf81a.why: The S&P 500 tracks 500 large US companies and is the main barometer of US equity performance. Nvidia is a leading maker of AI chips, so its share price influences broad market sentiment.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Nvidia was the heaviest drag on the market and faced valuation worries.

impacts.why: The article cites worries about bitcoin's high price alongside the stock sell-off.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

ncbebbaf81a.why_moved: Stocks fell after another jarring day, with investors worried that prices for Nvidia and bitcoin had risen too high. Nvidia was the heaviest drag on the market.

n54bcaf3694.headline: Japan movie releases postponed in China after Taiwan row
n54bcaf3694.summary: At least two popular Japanese films have had their releases postponed in China. The move comes as the two countries are locked in a dispute over Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's comments on Taiwan.
n54bcaf3694.why: Cultural and entertainment exports are a commercial channel between China and Japan. Diplomatic disputes can quickly affect cross-border business.

n75a7043679.headline: Japan warns citizens in China about safety amid diplomatic dispute
n75a7043679.summary: Japan has warned its citizens in China to step up safety precautions and avoid crowded places, amid a deepening dispute between Asia's two largest economies.
n75a7043679.why: China and Japan are Asia's two largest economies, so diplomatic friction between them affects trade, investment and regional risk sentiment.

n2396454bf4.headline: Passage of 2026 budget on track – Palace
n2396454bf4.summary: The proposed P6.793-trillion 2026 national budget remains on course for approval despite the resignation of budget secretary Amenah Pangandaman over corruption allegations, Malacañang said.
n2396454bf4.why: The national budget sets government spending and deficit targets, which influence fiscal policy and sovereign credit assessments.

na8c2476bcd.headline: Remolona signals cautious easing
na8c2476bcd.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Monetary Board remains inclined toward gradual policy easing as it evaluates a sharper-than-expected economic slowdown in the third quarter.
na8c2476bcd.why: The central bank sets policy rates for the Philippines, and its easing path affects local borrowing costs, the peso and domestic equities.

n594ace36be.headline: ‘Economy to expand below target in 2026’
n594ace36be.summary: The Department of Finance expects the Philippine economy to grow 5% to 6% next year, short of earlier targets amid slower-than-anticipated growth and lingering economic challenges.
n594ace36be.why: Official growth forecasts shape fiscal planning, corporate earnings expectations and investor views on Philippine assets.

n9d7e4ce5f1.headline: Govt approves Rs50b defence package to strengthen national security
n9d7e4ce5f1.summary: Pakistan's Economic Coordination Committee approved a Rs50 billion defence package to strengthen national security. It also approved technical supplementary grants of nearly Rs950 million for the Federal Civil Armed Forces.
n9d7e4ce5f1.why: Government defence spending affects the federal budget and fiscal deficit, which matter to investors assessing Pakistan's sovereign risk.

nf75ef4d706.headline: Carney supercharges B.C.’s northern grid ambitions with nation-building label
nf75ef4d706.summary: The federal government has given B.C.'s North Coast Transmission Line a nation-building label. The candidate says the line will power numerous other projects in the province's north.
nf75ef4d706.why: Transmission lines carry electricity from generation sources to users, and their construction supports power supply for resource and industrial projects.

ne1cf1476e2.headline: Why Canadians Are Still Skipping U.S. Travel
ne1cf1476e2.summary: Canadian air trips to the United States fell 23.9% year over year in October. A survey found 70% of Canadians said they would be uncomfortable travelling to the U.S.
ne1cf1476e2.why: Cross-border travel spending affects airlines, hotels and retailers in both countries, and travel volumes are tracked as an indicator of consumer demand.

n222a72487e.headline: Scotiabank shuffles executive ranks, Phil Thomas to take on COO role
n222a72487e.summary: Scotiabank has appointed Phil Thomas as group head and chief strategy and operating officer. He replaces Anique Asher, who had held the role since July 2024.
n222a72487e.why: Scotiabank is one of Canada's largest banks, and changes to its senior strategy roles can signal shifts in its priorities.

nb2402e7227.headline: New Life Sciences Fund and leadership churn reveal continued reset at BDC
nb2402e7227.summary: BDC has launched a new life sciences fund, and the leader of its Growth Venture Fund is leaving nine months after the fund received $1 billion. The mandate was also expanded.
nb2402e7227.why: BDC is Canada's state-owned development bank, and its venture and growth funds affect capital available to Canadian technology and life sciences firms.
